title: Ulyana and the Debt
premise: Rosalind Sterling, a hostage negotiator haunted by a failed extraction, is pulled back in when Flight 447 to Frankfurt vanishes from every tracking system mid-air—yet the plane is still flying. Aboard is Ulyana, a Russian defector carrying evidence of a financial conspiracy, and Rosalind realizes the erasure isn't a malfunction but an assassination by ledger: someone is deleting the plane, and everyone on it, from existence. Negotiating with a faceless adversary who controls the records of reality itself, Rosalind must land the plane and expose the debt before Frankfurt's markets open at dawn. She succeeds, but only by sacrificing her own spotless record, becoming deliberately unrecorded herself—the one person the system cannot find, and finally free to sleep.
about_author: Odile Fairweather is the pen name of a former aviation insurance analyst who spent a decade writing risk reports for aircraft that never crashed. She lives near a regional airstrip and claims the best thrillers are about paperwork.

chapters.title: The Incident Board
chapters.summary: Rosalind, insomniac and semi-retired from negotiation, keeps a whiteboard of her one failed case. A former colleague arrives with an impossible report: Flight 447 exists in no database, though radar techs watched it climb. POV: Rosalind. Emotional beat: dread reawakening—the board is about to gain a second name.

chapters.title: Ghost Altitude
chapters.summary: Rosalind traces a garbled radio relay from the flight and hears Ulyana's voice—calm, accented, describing men moving toward the cockpit. The airline denies the flight number ever existed. POV: Rosalind, intercut with Ulyana's log entries. Emotional beat: vertigo; the ground truth is dissolving.

chapters.title: The Erasure Firm
chapters.summary: Following a payment trail, Rosalind finds a boutique consultancy that sells 'narrative insolvency'—making liabilities, human or financial, disappear before settlement. Its client list is a shell of shells. POV: Rosalind. Emotional beat: cold clarity; this is a business, and business is punctual.

chapters.title: Ulyana Speaks
chapters.summary: Through a patched satellite uplink, Rosalind negotiates with Ulyana directly, learning she carries a ledger proving Western banks laundered a sanctioned fortune. The plane's transponder dies. POV: dual—Rosalind in a rented operations room, Ulyana in the darkening cabin. Emotional beat: two strangers building trust across static.

chapters.title: Diversion
chapters.summary: The erasure firm's fixer, Callum Voss, contacts Rosalind—not with threats but an offer: her failed incident will be officially rewritten as a success if she walks away. POV: Rosalind. Emotional beat: temptation sharpened into insult; they think her guilt is a price tag.

chapters.title: Passengers as Collateral
chapters.summary: Ulyana organizes the cabin while hijackers disguised as air marshals seal the cockpit. Rosalind coaches a flight attendant through a comm panel repair, negotiating minute by minute. POV: Ulyana primary. Emotional beat: agency—the hostage becomes the negotiator's hands.

chapters.title: The Debt Comes Due
chapters.summary: Rosalind discovers the conspiracy's anchor: a dawn derivatives position in Frankfurt that only pays if Flight 447 is never confirmed to have existed. The erasure is a hedge. POV: Rosalind, racing a filing deadline. Emotional beat: fury crystallizing into strategy.

chapters.title: Descent Without Permission
chapters.summary: With the cockpit sealed, Ulyana's allies among the crew execute a cabin-side emergency descent protocol while Rosalind floods air traffic frequencies with the flight's true identity—making erasure audible. Voss moves to intercept her physically. POV: dual, converging. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration braided together.

chapters.title: Frankfurt, 05:59
chapters.summary: The plane lands on a closed strip as markets open; Rosalind broadcasts the ledger to every terminal before the first trade settles. Voss corners her in the operations room, and she talks him down—not with a deal, but with the truth of what he's become. POV: Rosalind. Emotional beat: the climax—words as the only weapon left, used perfectly.

chapters.title: Unrecorded
chapters.summary: Testimony scatters the conspiracy, but Rosalind learns her own file has been quietly deleted as payment for her silence's opposite: she chose erasure over compromise. She burns the incident board, sleeps a full night, and meets Ulyana at a small airfield—two women outside the record, finally belonging to themselves. POV: Rosalind. Emotional beat: release; justice outside the law, memory kept by choice.
